summary: Iter 3 testing complete. 15/15 new backend pytest tests pass (test_iter3.py). Verified: (1) folder_code generation (YYMMDD-CODE##-CLIENT-PROJECT) including per-platform-per-date seq increments (MGSIKA01→02) and independent counters per platform (LLCHRM01 on same date); (2) PUT regenerates folder_code only when tanggal/platform/klien/project change and keeps stable on non-critical edits; (3) GET /api/earnings returns {by_month, by_platform_month} with April 2026 gross=27.9M / fee=9.66M / net=18.24M / count=12 matching seeded data; (4) GET /api/freelance per-artist aggregation with fee split (e.g., 1,200,000/2 = 600,000 verified); rows count equals sum of artists across orders with fee>0; (5) Settings schema migrated fonnte→telegram (telegram_bot_token/telegram_chat_id seeded from .env, old fonnte_token/admin_wa absent); (6) POST /settings/test-telegram returned 200 {ok:true} with real creds (one-shot manual test) and 400 when creds blank; (7) All 17 expanded STATUS values accepted; (8) DONE_STATUSES constant contains done/delivered/cancel; (9) 12 seed April orders present with all new fields populated. Frontend Playwright verified: all 8 nav items render for admin (dashboard/orders/board/invoice/earning/freelance/archive/settings); Orders page new columns (PLATFORM/MARKETER/ORDER ID/FOLDER CODE/FEE) all present; 12 order-row + 12 invoice-btn for April filter; 'Buat Invoice' button navigates to /invoice?orderId=xxx correctly; OrderModal shows LIVE folder-code preview updating on input (typed PreviewCo/Demo X/2027-07-15 → got '270715-MGSIKA01-PREVIEWCO-DEMO X', switching platform to Etsy regenerated as '270715-LLCHRM01-PREVIEWCO-DEMO X'); Archive page renders 4 done+past-month rows with search/month/export-csv controls; Earning page shows earn-current + earn-by-month + earn-pivot; Freelance page (Apr 2026) shows 3 artist cards Joko/Sari/Budi totaling Rp9.66M matching earnings fee; Board shows 3 active columns; Settings page has Telegram Bot Token (seeded '8504165985:AAFb...') + Chat ID '1415837440' + test-telegram-btn (NOT fonnte — word absent from page).

minor.issue: Folder-code regen uses a temporary '__tmp__' platform write to exclude the current order from the count, but if the request fails between the tmp-write and the regenerate step, the order is left with platform='__tmp__'. Edge case only — no error seen in tests.
No month filter query param; frontend must fetch full dataset then filter client-side. Fine for current scale (<=5000 orders) but worth flagging.

issues: The data-testid attributes on stat cards are 'stat-total-project' / 'stat-total-value' / 'stat-done' / 'stat-net' / 'stat-unpaid' (not 'stat-value' as listed in review_request). Each card also has a twin '<id>-value' for the number element. Naming mismatch vs. spec is minor — functional UI is correct, but tests should use 'stat-total-value' to get the gross-value card.

'Selesai bulan ini' (done-section) is not rendered when there are no done orders in the current system month. With seed data in 2026-04 and system clock in 2026-05, no done items match → section hidden. Behaviour is defensible but might surprise reviewers; consider always rendering the heading with an empty-state hint.
WebSocket first-connect logs 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warning — pre-existing from iter 1/2, not user-visible.

action_items: Optional: align dashboard data-testid naming with review_request spec — rename 'stat-total-value' → 'stat-value' (and similar) if external tests depend on the documented names.
Optional: always render Board 'Selesai bulan ini' section with empty-state text when 0 done-this-month items so reviewers see it.
Optional: wrap the PUT /orders folder_code regeneration in a try/except so a failed regen rolls back the '__tmp__' platform marker.

Note: iter2 test file test_iter2.py now has FAILING Settings tests because the schema changed (fonnte_token/admin_wa removed). Either mark those tests as xfail/obsolete or rewrite them for Telegram. I did NOT run test_iter2.py in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_folder_code: race condition possible on concurrent POSTs of same date+platform — count_documents is not atomic with insert. Under current single-user admin load fine; if multi-user parallel creation is expected, switch to a counter collection with $inc findAndModify.
server.py PUT /orders regenerate path writes '__tmp__' as platform then recalculates — non-atomic. If the request raises between these two writes the order is left corrupted.
server.py reminder_loop still uses blocking requests inside an async coroutine (send_telegram). Low frequency (every 10 min) so acceptable but consider httpx.AsyncClient.
server.py earnings/freelance do full-collection scan each call (find({}).to_list(5000)). Add month query param + index on tanggal for scale.
server.py DONE_STATUSES has typo 'cancle' kept alongside 'cancel' — harmless defensive duplication.

server.py sanitize_upper strips all punctuation then collapses spaces but keeps spaces inside the project part of folder_code (e.g. 'DEMO X' with a space). If downstream Google Drive folder creation has issues with spaces, replace spaces with '_' or '-' for project_part.
Frontend OrderModal: folder-code-preview shows '—' when klien or project is empty — correct UX.
Frontend: 12 order rows render correctly, each with invoice-btn (Buat Invoice shortcut) navigating to /invoice?orderId=xxx — pre-selection verified via URL param.
test_credentials: OAuth-based; test admin session seeded directly in mongo test_database (cleaned up post-test). Telegram real creds preserved in settings (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID from .env). /api/settings/test-telegram called exactly once in this iteration — returned 200 {ok:true}.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. 12 April 2026 sample orders remain intact (gross 27.9M / fee 9.66M). All test users + sessions cleaned up post-test. 3 pre-existing admin/member users remain in DB (magsikastudio@gmail.com + admin@e2e.test + admin@t.test).
